# Function loadAllSkillsInDir

  * loadAllSkillsInDir(skillsBasePath: string): Promise<Record<string, [Skill](../interfaces/Skill.html)>>

Loads all skills located within subdirectories of a given base path.

#### Parameters

    * skillsBasePath: string

The base directory containing individual skill subdirectories.

#### Returns Promise<Record<string, [Skill](../interfaces/Skill.html)>>

A promise that resolves to a map of skill names to their corresponding Skill objects.
